en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large ancient stone monument in ruins, richly decorated with sculpted reliefs. The structure stands on a rocky base with a partially preserved upper section. A small human figure at the lower right provides scale. At the top right there is a Greek postage stamp with a postmark. Printed caption text appears beneath the image identifying the monument and location.
